name: When should I consider a custom floor plan instead of a standard one?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider a custom floor plan instead of a standard one?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider a custom floor plan if you have specific spatial requirements, unique lifestyle needs, or a particular vision that standard layouts cannot accommodate. This includes specialized storage needs, a dedicated workspace, accessibility features, or unique appliance placements. A custom plan ensures every inch of your tiny home is optimized to support your daily life and preferences, rather than adapting to a pre-set design.
acceptedAnswer.description: Opt for a custom plan if standard layouts don't meet your unique spatial requirements, lifestyle needs, or specific vision for your tiny home.
